gatePolicy.existingGates: Unchanged in XCTest and CI; this evidence collector does not enable or replace them.
gatePolicy.postChange: document-after-optimized.json; all 20 process runs captured on the same reference runner. See document-after-optimized.md for absolute/relative variance. Every existing absolute ceiling passes without a budget or relative-allowance change. document-after.json preserves the intermediate capture that identified redundant persistence decodes.
gatePolicy.processes: Five independent processes for each suite and configuration, run serially.
gatePolicy.scope: Separate synchronous native acceptance, first native paint, prepared presentation convergence, viewport work and background save/history/recovery/restore distributions. First-paint/convergence metrics are new and have no before-change baseline.
gatePolicy.smallSampleLimitation: For 9, 10 or 35 measured samples, p99 is the maximum, not a well-resolved tail estimate.

protocol.percentile: nearest-rank over post-warmup samples within each process
protocol.reason: Evidence collection only; existing test assertions and CI budgets are unchanged.
protocol.testability: ENABLE_TESTABILITY=YES; Debug default, explicit for Release; optimization unchanged
protocol.warmup: Initial samples omitted only from structured distributions; original gates use all samples.
